title: DecisionMemoryContract
description: Schema for persisted operational decision memories and closed-loop prediction-vs-actual outcomes.

decision_id.description: Unique identifier for this logged decision event.

operator_id.description: Operator who evaluated and chose the trajectory.

machine_id.description: Machine operated during the decision point.

task_id.description: Task during which the decision was made.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of decision commit.

context_signature.description: Feature vector hash or canonical encoding of operational context for similarity lookups.

available_scenarios.description: List of scenario IDs presented to the operator.

chosen_scenario.description: ID of the scenario selected by human choice.

predicted_outcome.description: Multidimensional predicted metrics at the moment of decision.

actual_outcome.description: Measured real-world outcome recorded after trajectory execution.

prediction_error.description: Computed delta between predicted outcome and actual outcome.

operator_reason.description: Operator-provided rationale or note recorded with choice.
